notes: Replay is modeled as re-submitting the same certificate + same T. With a fresh nonce the old certificate no longer matches; f=0 has no freshness at all, so replay is accepted.
verifier-only protects V's view of T, not U's delivery: U has no nonce and the certificate carries no end_user_binding, so a divergent delivery is accepted by U.
end-user uses the separate domain pop-bind-enduser-v1 and rejects divergent delivery. The circuit still commits the verifier-domain response_binding; end_user_binding is a certificate-layer add-on.
